source_clause: NOPR1.1) The user does not need to customize the Default Profile(s) before creating a different new Profile. Driver 1 and any other default Profiles will remain on the vehicle until a user customizes or deletes it.
leaf_desc_037: NOPR1.1) The user does not need to customize the Default Profile(s) before creating a different new Profile. Driver 1 and any other default Profiles will remain on the vehicle until a user customizes or deletes it.
reasoning: 驗證目標：6.2.1（NOPR1.1）之兩項斷言 —— 建新 profile 不需先客製化預設 profile，且 Driver 1 與其他預設 profile 會留在車上直到被客製化或刪除。關鍵情境條件：兩者為同一觸發（建立新 profile）之兩個結果，依 §5.7 併於一條 TC 之兩條 ER，不拆。為什麼這樣切：以步驟 1 之記錄作為基準線，步驟 3 比對其存續（§5.6）。刻意略過：客製化或刪除後預設 profile 之消失，屬其反面條件，由 6.2 之其他 leaf 承擔。

tcs.tc_title: Default Profiles remain after a new Profile is created
tcs.test_item: Default Profiles remain after a new Profile is created
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle carries its default Profiles, including Driver 1
2. No default Profile has been customized or deleted
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Profile List and record the default Profiles present
2. Create a new Driver Profile without customizing any default Profile
3. Open the Profile List and check that the default Profiles recorded in step 1 are still present
tcs.expected_result:
1. The default Profiles, including Driver 1, are recorded
2. The new Driver Profile is created and no default Profile is customized
3. The default Profiles recorded in step 1 are still present
tcs.priority_basis: 建立新 profile 之次要性質（預設 profile 之存續）—— 主要功能之次要操作
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
